title: Support reactions
assumptions: Supports are ideal: A is a pin and B is a roller.
Positive y is upward and counterclockwise moments are positive.

equations.title: Horizontal force equilibrium
equations.explanation: No external horizontal load is applied, so the horizontal pin reaction is zero.

equations.title: Moment equilibrium about A
equations.explanation: Taking moments about A eliminates A_x and A_y, because their lines of action pass through point A.

equations.title: Vertical force equilibrium
equations.explanation: After B_y is known, vertical force equilibrium gives the remaining vertical reaction at A.

steps.title: 1. Identify unknown reactions
steps.body: Support A is a pin, so it can provide A_x and A_y. Support B is a roller, so it provides only B_y.

steps.title: 2. Replace supports with reaction forces
steps.body: The beam is isolated. The downward load is 12 kN at x = 3 m, and supports are replaced by their reaction components.

steps.title: 3. Apply horizontal equilibrium
steps.body: There are no applied horizontal forces, so the pin has no horizontal reaction.

steps.title: 4. Take moments about A
steps.body: The moment arm for B_y is 6 m. The moment arm for the load is 3 m.

steps.title: 5. Apply vertical equilibrium
steps.body: The upward reactions must balance the downward point load.

steps.title: 6. Summarize reactions
steps.body: The final support reactions are listed below.
